heading: Art. 86. Absence without leave
lead: Any member of the armed forces who, without authority— shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

tree.text: fails to go to his appointed place of duty at the time prescribed;
absents himself or remains absent from his unit, organization, or place of duty at which he is required to be at the time prescribed;
